fusions.name: Ram From the Ledge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to a target and ram it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cliffside Stamp
fusions.desc: You rear and drop onto the rock, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Bosses and elites also lose 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Won't Be Shifted
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Refuses the Fall
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused, leaving you at 1 health.
